conviction_note: Event confirmed for 2026-10-28 as an in-session release (kabutan's schedule lists 1930 under 取引時間中の発表; the last H1 and Q1 both came at 13:00), so the window runs from the 1509 yen sealed spot. The findings net slightly positive (+0.4): Q1 put H1 ordinary profit 40.7% of the way to plan and Hokkaido Denko just printed +77% for H1, and the DOE 3% policy points to a higher dividend; against that, H1 orders will print about 30% down on last year's record. The scaled number is slightly negative (p_up 47 on a 5.0 scale) because this name has fallen after its last three interim prints, including -2% on a 2.2x H1 beat in 2024 when the full-year plan was held, and margin longs outnumber margin shorts 51 to 1. The gap in sign between the two numbers is the reaction function overriding a modestly positive fundamental read.
bar: Company H1 (4-9月) forecast from the FY2026 決算短信 of 2026-04-28: revenue 30,000m yen, operating profit 2,000m, ordinary profit 2,200m, net profit 1,500m; full year 70,000 / 6,000 / 6,200 / 4,100; dividend 48 yen (24 interim). Restated unchanged in the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260724598854.pdf). I found no 四季報 or IFIS consensus, so the bar is the company plan only and every finding is sized small. print_vs_bar_pct is measured on H1 ordinary profit against 2,200m.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-27: 0.0% (no disclosed position at or above 0.5%), change 0.0. 信用倍率 51.33x (baseline; kabutan shows the same 51.33x on 2026-10-28), a heavily crowded margin long, so a disappointment has sellers waiting. No skew exists: there are no single-stock options. Run-up -3.64% over 20 days, +1.48% over 5. Composite priced_lean -0.67, driven by the margin overhang.

findings.finding: H1 ordinary profit is tracking at or slightly above the 2,200m plan. Q1 ordinary was 895m, 40.7% of the H1 plan against a 5-year average of 33.7% at Q1. Q1 operating margin rose from 3.2% to 5.6% on price pass-through. Q2 needs ordinary profit of about 1,305m, +33% on last year's 978m, which a +10-15% sales rise at an operating margin of 7-8% delivers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY2025 (2024-10-29, 15:00): ordinary 1,415m against a 650m plan, a 2.2x beat with the full year held; the stock rose 0.8% that day and fell 2.9% the next, about -2% over the window. H1 FY2026 (2025-10-29, 13:00): ordinary 1,461m against a 1,900m plan, a 23% miss; -8.1% (1499 to 1378). So at H1 this name punishes misses and sells beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades at 1509, below where it stood before Q1 (1638), because the July sell-off was about orders, not profit. If the market were pricing a clean H1 beat, the stock would have recovered toward the pre-Q1 level, and a PER of 10.1 on a plan the company beat by about 30% last year would not hold. The partial reason it is not priced is that this company's H1 record is erratic (2.2x beat in 2024, 23% miss in 2025), so nobody trusts the progress rate.
findings.independence: Peer read-through: Hokkaido Denko (1832) H1 ordinary +76.5%, released 2026-10-27, with Q2 +14.8% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1832&b=k202610270014). Margin data is from the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260724598854.pdf), the same company document as the source.

findings.finding: H1 orders (受注高) will print roughly 30% below last year. The comp is a record H1 FY2026 of 43,660m (+66.6%), including Q2 orders of 17,326m. Q1 orders were 13,679m (-48.1%), including a negative -977m in 送変電・土木 from Noto cancellations. Getting near flat would need Q2 orders of about 30bn. This is the line that sent the stock down 10% on 2026-07-28. The offset: backlog should hold near last year's 66.8bn (Q1-end backlog was 64,724m, +3%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-28: profit 2.1x but orders -48.1%; the stock fell 10.0% (1638 to 1475) on 931k shares, and kabutan/minkabu headlined the orders. 2025-10-29: orders +66.6% but the profit miss dominated (-8.1%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Q1 is public, and anyone can do the H1 arithmetic from the two 短信. What may not be priced is the size of the headline: retail-heavy holders reacted to the y/y headline in July, not to the backlog, and margin longs (51x) bought that dip. If the decline were fully priced, the margin long book would have unwound since July instead of staying crowded.
findings.independence: Q1 orders and backlog: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260724598854.pdf. The July reaction to the orders headline: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1930&b=n202607280756. All of these come from the company's own documents, so this is one fact.

findings.finding: The stated DOE 3.0% dividend policy implies a payout above the 48 yen held in the plan if profit grows. Imamura Securities' analyst wrote that maintaining DOE 3% requires a raise (my estimate: about 52 yen on average equity of about 47.5bn). A raise of the year-end dividend could come with this H1 release, but the company's pattern is to raise at the full-year print (FY2026: 44 to 48 announced on 2026-04-28; none at H1 2025).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only dividend change in the record, the 2026-04-28 増配 together with the FY beat and guide, was followed by +4% and then +12%; that cannot be separated from the earnings beat.
findings.why_not_priced: A 3.18% yield at 48 yen is what the price reflects. A raise to about 52 at H1 would lift it to about 3.4%, and nothing in the price or the 0.90 PBR suggests the market expects an H1 raise. Probability-weighted at about 20% for an H1 announcement.
findings.independence: The policy is in the company's own FY results materials, and the 48 yen hold is in the Q1 短信 dividend table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260724598854.pdf). The 2026-04-28 増配 notice is https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260428/140120260424510363/.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. The company held the full year at H1 in both FY2025 (despite a 2.2x H1 beat) and FY2026 (and beat that plan by about 30% unrevised), so a held 6,200m is the base case and neutral. Returns: a DOE-3% 増配 is possible but historically comes at the FY print (about 20%). New-year guide: n/a. Quarter: Q1 progress 40.7% of H1 plan against a 5-year average of 33.7%; H1 is expected around or slightly above plan; H1 orders about -30% y/y against a record comp.

baseline_tension: The findings sum is slightly positive (+0.4), against a baseline lean of -0.67 (margin overhang) and a -3.6% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is an H1 beat plus a DOE-driven 増配. I looked for both: the beat looks likely to be modest, and the dividend raise has historically come only at the FY print. The name's own H1 reaction history (beats sold, misses punished) and the 51x margin long keep p_up just under 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the H1 orders decline is arithmetic from the public Q1 and prior-H1 短信, so that finding went from -1.0 to -0.6 and p_up from 45 to 47.
Rule 2 (check the sign): I wrote the strongest positive (H1 beat plus DOE 増配) into baseline_tension and had already searched for both; the positive findings were left unchanged.
